## Highlights

### 🐛 Cyberpunk 2077 starts without `-modded` when no REDmod is installed
NMA always started Cyberpunk 2077 with `-modded`. With it, the game uses the scripts and TweakDB that REDmod deployed
in `r6/cache/modded`. Without any REDmod installed, these are what an earlier deploy left, and they are out of date
after a game update. Redscript mods then failed to compile (about 1,900 errors after the 2.50 update), while they
worked when the game was started directly. NMA now only passes `-modded` when a REDmod is installed (#29).

This applies to games started through Steam or Heroic: NMA passes no launch arguments to Lutris.

### 🔄 Updates of renamed files
The update check only found a newer file on a mod page when its name was the same as the installed file's, version
aside. Authors often rename the file with a new version ("Foo" then "Foo V2", "Foo for 2.31" then "Foo for 2.50"), and
these updates weren't shown. NMA now finds them when the new file has a higher version number (#30):
- Files that only differ by a number, like "Part 1" and "Part 2", stay different files.
- A mod page that keeps one file per game version now offers the file for the newest game version as an update.

### 🛡️ Dependencies
- Avalonia, the interface framework, goes from 11.3.5 to 11.3.23.
- `Microsoft.AspNetCore.WebUtilities` 10.0.15 fixes CVE-2026-114149 (high severity). NMA only uses this package to
  build URLs and wasn't exposed in practice.

Thanks to dubzilla1 for #28, #29 and #30.

## Full changelog

- `fix(cyberpunk)` launch with -modded only when a REDmod is installed
- `fix(updates)` recognize a renamed file as an update of the same file
- `fix(redmod)` pass -root and quote the deploy arguments on Windows
- `fix(deps)` update Avalonia to 11.3.23
- `fix(deps)` update Microsoft.AspNetCore.WebUtilities to 10.0.15

## Install

Download `NMAcommunity.App.x86_64.AppImage` below, `chmod +x`, run.
